别运行，，，
```{r}
ChnoutSIMPLE <- Chnoutline %>%
  st_simplify(., dTolerance = 1000) %>%
  st_geometry()%>%
  plot()
#plot(Chnoutline$geom)
```
```{r}
Chntemp <- Chnoutline %>%
  # now crop our temp data to the extent
  terra::crop(worldclimtemp,.)

# plot the output
plot(Chntemp)
```
```{r}
exactChn<-terra::mask(Chntemp, Chnoutline)
```
```{r}
names(exactChn)
```
```{r}
library(tidyterra)
ggplot() +
  # function from tidyterra
  geom_spatraster(
    # the raster 
    data = exactChn,
    # the layer within the raster
    aes(fill = ssp126_Aug)
  )
```
宽表转长表
```{r}
exactChndf <- exactChn %>%
  as.data.frame()
```
```{r}
names(exactChndf)
ncol(exactChndf)
head(exactChndf)
```

```{r}
squishdata <- exactChndf %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 1:24,
    names_to = "Layer",
    values_to = "Temp"
  )
head(squishdata)
```

```{r}
data_complete_cases <- squishdata %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    Layer = factor(
      Layer,
      levels = c(
        paste0("ssp126_", month.abb),
        paste0("ssp585_", month.abb)
      )
    )
  )

ggplot(data_complete_cases, aes(x = Temp)) +
  geom_histogram(color = "black", binwidth = 5) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Maximum Temperature in China",
    x = "Temperature",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  facet_grid(Layer ~ .) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
```{r}
# mean per month
meanofall <- squishdata %>%
  group_by(Layer) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(Temp, na.rm=TRUE))

# print the top 1
head(meanofall, n=1)
```
```{r}
# standard deviation per month
sdofall <- squishdata %>%
  group_by(Layer) %>%
  summarize(sd = sd(Temp, na.rm=TRUE))

# maximum per month
maxofall <- squishdata %>%
  group_by(Layer) %>%
  summarize(max = max(Temp, na.rm=TRUE))

# minimum per month
minofall <- squishdata %>%
  group_by(Layer) %>%
  summarize(min = min(Temp, na.rm=TRUE))

# Interquartlie range per month
IQRofall <- squishdata %>%
  group_by(Layer) %>%
  summarize(IQR = IQR(Temp, na.rm=TRUE))

# perhaps you want to store multiple outputs in one list..
lotsofstats <- squishdata %>%
  group_by(Layer) %>%
  summarize(IQR = IQR(Temp, na.rm=TRUE), 
            max=max(Temp, na.rm=T))

# or you want to know the mean (or some other stat) 
#for the whole year as opposed to each month...

meanwholeyear=squishdata %>%
  summarize(meanyear = mean(Temp, na.rm=TRUE))
```


```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)

cities <- st_read("data/wk3/World_Cities.geojson")
```
```{r}
st_geometry_type(cities)
```
```{r}
names(cities)
```

```{r}
china_cities <- cities %>%
  filter(CNTRY_NAME == "China")
View(china_cities)
```
提取每个城市气温
```{r}
city_temp <- terra::extract(exactChn, china_cities)
view(city_temp)
```
表中中增加城市名
```{r}
city_temp_wide <- bind_cols(
  tibble(CITY_NAME = china_cities$CITY_NAME),
  as_tibble(city_temp) %>%
    select(-ID)
)
```
```{r}
city_comparison <- city_temp_wide %>%
  transmute(
    CITY_NAME,
    Jan = ssp585_Jan - ssp126_Jan,
    Feb = ssp585_Feb - ssp126_Feb,
    Mar = ssp585_Mar - ssp126_Mar,
    Apr = ssp585_Apr - ssp126_Apr,
    May = ssp585_May - ssp126_May,
    Jun = ssp585_Jun - ssp126_Jun,
    Jul = ssp585_Jul - ssp126_Jul,
    Aug = ssp585_Aug - ssp126_Aug,
    Sep = ssp585_Sep - ssp126_Sep,
    Oct = ssp585_Oct - ssp126_Oct,
    Nov = ssp585_Nov - ssp126_Nov,
    Dec = ssp585_Dec - ssp126_Dec
  )
```
```{r}
monthly_summary <- city_comparison %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      Jan:Dec,
      list(
        mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  )
```
